description: This file is a C++ source code implementing an OpenGL ES rendering application for the Raspberry Pi 4 platform, involving EGL context creation, window management, and animated scene rendering with color and position changes.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Manages EGL context, window, and rendering loop for animated OpenGL ES scene.

methods.name: Application
methods.description: Constructor that initializes EGL, creates window, configures surface and context, and starts rendering.

methods.name: ~Application
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up EGL resources and window.

methods.name: RenderScene
methods.description: Renders a frame with animated position and color, then schedules next frame.

methods.name: RenderSceneEventCallback
methods.description: Static callback forwarding event to instance method.
